output.summary: The backlog growth is mostly self-inflicted by the close quota, not demand, effort, capacity or Payroll. First-contact issues rose only 4%; the surge is agent-created splits, duplicates and reopens. Closes per day rose from 11.7 to 19.0 with unchanged hours, and the reopen rise is real, not a config artifact. Quota-driven gaming is shown by the oldest-first pick drop and the exempt Billing pod's flat trend. Escalated Engineering bugs may explain aged complex tickets, but linkage is unestablished. Raising the quota (A1) is harmful, and hiring 12 agents (A2) is premature. Replacing the quota with team quality measures (A3) and classifying aged tickets by blocker (A4) are preferred.
